clips.title: The story
paras: Corruption is spreading through Darkshore, where Tharnariun Treetender hopes to save the afflicted wildlife. He asks travelers to calm a rabid thistle bear with an enchanted relic and bring it back alive.

A creeping sickness twists Darkshore’s beasts into maddened, aggressive versions of themselves. Thistle bears suffer most, their rabid frenzy threatening travelers and the coast’s fragile balance. Night elf sentinels often answer with steel, while druids seek to understand the sickness and heal its cause.

Tharnariun Treetender refuses to kill the corrupted beasts without first trying to save them. He made a trap called Tharnariun’s Hope. Set on the forest floor, its soothing light briefly calms a raging thistle bear. Pacified, the bear follows the traveler back to Tharnariun’s outpost for study.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A sickness spreads across the Darkshore, gripping the minds and bodies of all it touches.
The Thistle Bears have been hit the hardest by this plague. The once noble beasts are now an instrument of destruction - rabid and frenzied. I may have a cure for this ailment.

Take this trap to the forest and lay it on the ground. Any Rabid Thistle Bear that crosses the light shall become docile for a short time. Once the bear is docile, it shall follow you. Lead it back here, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you brought me the sick animal, friend?
Should you fail to spring the trap, do not fret - Tharnariun's Hope is eternal. If you require another trap, abandon your task and report back to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Our work has only just begun, friend. Are you prepared for your next task?
